reuse.why: Extends getNextDate and reuses getDateWithSkippedWeekend and d.isWeekend, but getUpcomingDates writes its own daily-skip filter instead of sharing one helper, and schedule-template's own weekend ternary is left on the old rule.

duplication.why: The daily-skip rule is coded in getNextDate and again in getUpcomingDates, and inside getNextDate the take/filter pair is repeated for the forward and reverse queries.

placement.why: The rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts and is there, but server/schedules/app.ts re-decides it locally and budget/schedule-template.ts keeps deciding weekend moves itself.

scope.why: Minimal edits to the two date functions and one test.

maintainability.why: Two independent encodings with different arbitrary lookahead bounds (3 and count*3) plus an untouched third path in schedule-template make the rule easy to break or miss next time.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates filters weekend dates itself rather than going through a shared occurrence-adjustment helper; budget/schedule-template.ts keeps its own getDateWithSkippedWeekend ternary

one_place.where: Daily weekend skip decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates; budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList still moves daily weekend occurrences with its own ternary
